text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through summer training camp, Nishino 
Flower had definitely grown stronger. It 
seemed to have given her confidence, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phaaah.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to run, so I was holding 
myself back!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I ran a lot during the 
training camp, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how I want to race 
soon... It makes my heart race just 
thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I wish race day would hurry up 
and get here.
choice_data_list: First, we should get back to the academy.

Getting back to the academy comes first, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe... I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for your hard work!
choice_data_list: Take your time and get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you too, Trainer! See you tomorrow 
then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Nishino Flower off to the 
dorms, I head back to the academy to get 
some work done. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp... sure was hot, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My body is still feeling a bit flushed. I 
think I'll go rest somewhere quiet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it looks like it'll take a while 
to fall asleep. ...Could you tell me a 
bedtime story?”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You might already know this~, but Flower 
really loves flowers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After following Seiun Sky for a while, she 
smoothly began to speak in the middle of 
our casual conversation—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She especially seems to love the tiny, 
cute ones that try their absolute hardest 
to bloom.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When I asked, "Why?" what do you think 
they said?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "It gives me courage." ...She said.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that just like these little 
ones, even if I'm small, I'll be able to 
bloom beautifully one day. Just thinking 
about that makes me happy"...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know if I'd call it admirable 
or what. Humility, maybe... or just a 
total lack of confidence."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because those flowers bloomed so 
beautifully only because someone cared for 
them and wished for them to grow, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's nature... or a little 
Umamusume, whatever it is, you can't just 
bloom 'beautifully' all on your own."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even though she's the one giving, it feels 
like she's the one receiving. Maybe that's 
just her kindness, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think part of it is because they feel it 
wasn't accomplished by their own strength 
alone~.
choice_data_list: ..."So make sure to cheer her up, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I didn't say anything like that, 
though?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, for some reason, compliments are so 
easy to forget, aren't they~?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why having the person closest to 
them keep cheering them on... is a good 
thing, right? Probably.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "I see"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta love that sheer honesty.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I've been thinking this for a while 
now... but you two really are cut from the 
same cloth, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Ah, I'm getting kind of sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm okay now, so... Good night...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, our first summer training camp 
came to a peaceful close."
